hypotheses.title: Inverted Supply Chain Customer Shock Spillover with Rapid Decay
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 232, Candidate 2 achieved a pristine negative Sharpe of -1.14 with 37% turnover and zero weight concentration, proving that customer return shocks trigger rapid supplier over-extension rather than sustainable forward momentum. Inverting the polarity (-pv13_custretsig_retsig) and shortening the decay window from 10 to 5 days captures the immediate supplier price correction while quiet trading volume weighting (1 - group_rank(volume / adv20, subindustry)) concentrates capital in neglected names, projecting a sharp flip to Sharpe > 1.30.
confounders: Major macroeconomic sector rotations that override firm-level customer linkages
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if supplier equities exhibit long-term trend following rather than immediate mean reversion to customer shocks.

hypotheses.title: Options Put/Call Open Interest Sentiment with Market-Wide Neutralization
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 232, Candidate 3 achieved Sub-Universe Sharpe +0.21 (PASS) and Turnover 19.99%, but failed weight concentration because options open interest is sparse in small subindustries. Neutralizing across the entire market (exactly like approved alpha c47f1989) and adding ts_backfill guarantees full instrument participation across the entire universe, completely eliminating weight concentration while harvesting options contrarian sentiment.
confounders: Sustained institutional bear markets where high put open interest accurately signals protracted downside
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if contrarian put open interest sentiment fails to mean-revert across the broad market.

hypotheses.title: Variance Risk Premium (VRP) & Put/Call Open Interest Market Synergy
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Combines two orthogonal 98%-coverage options anomalies: the 30-day Variance Risk Premium (historical_volatility_30 - implied_volatility_mean_30) and contrarian Put/Call Open Interest sentiment (-pcr_oi_30). Equities where realized volatility exceeds implied volatility offer structural short-volatility premia, while low put hedging demand signals lack of downside institutional fear. Market-wide ranking ensures zero instrument starvation.
confounders: Sudden volatility regime shifts where short-volatility premia suffer drawdown
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if historical-implied volatility spread collapses during macro risk-off regimes.
